plan.summary: BRO-5623 (part a): Fizzle/Flop must rest on an estimate (owner 2026-10-18). Five default Fizzles that our model (decent inputs) puts under 30% become Flop; six default Fizzles with no estimate at all become Undisclosed (TBD, flagged for research).
steps: Each edit reads its oldValue from live commercial.json.

actions.description: tootsie-2019: Fizzle claims 30% or more returned with no estimate behind it (the old default); our model, with decent inputs, puts about -6% returned, under 30%, so Flop (owner decision 2026-10-18, option A).

the-whos-tommy: Fizzle claims 30% or more returned with no estimate behind it (the old default); our model, with decent inputs, puts about 10% returned, under 30%, so Flop (owner decision 2026-10-18, option A).

liberation: matches every other closed show shown as Undisclosed: no recoupment was announced, so the outcome stays unknown rather than "did not recoup".
